taxline.menuEntry: Enter investment expense paid or accrued in 2023.

taxline.name: 04a
taxline.menuEntry: Enter gross income from property held for investment.

taxline.name: 04b
taxline.menuEntry: Enter qualified dividends included on line 4a.

taxline.name: 04d
taxline.menuEntry: Enter net gain from the disposition of property held for investment.

taxline.name: 04e
taxline.menuEntry: Enter the smaller of line 4d or your net capital gain from the disposition of property held for investment.

taxline.name: 04g
taxline.menuEntry: Enter the amount from lines 4b and 4e that you elect to include in investment income.
